integrity.computational_basis: Exhaustive enumeration, explicitly certified acyclic discrete-Morse matching, unit integral cancellations and separate mod-two/symmetry checkers in this package.
integrity.scientific_scope: Finite exact topological computation; no generalized statement beyond the named graph.

scientific_limitations: Only the fully bidirected three-rung ladder is classified, not ladders of arbitrary length.
The theorem determines integral homology and rational symmetry representations; it does not determine a full homotopy type or Steenrod operations.
Novelty comparisons are bounded by access and indexing; some relevant published mathematical records have only title/abstract inspection.
title: Integral multipath homology and symmetries of the three-rung ladder
